name: Your Turn to Die: -Jackleg Participants-
source:
High-schooler Ranmaru Kageyama wakes up in an unknown location, unable to remember how they got there, and is forced to do fatal tasks. Soon, they realize he finds out he's trapped with another group of 9 people to participate in a death game. Nothing could prepare Ranmaru for what he's about to experience. With risks around every corner and an unwelcoming bunch, some might say they're too clumsy to be in such a game.

[From [url=https://sanguine1038.itch.io/jackleg-participants]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高中生兰丸影山在一个未知的地方醒来，不记得自己是如何到达那里的，并被迫执行致命的任务。很快，他们意识到他发现自己和另一群九人被困一起参加一场死亡游戏。兰丸无法为即将经历的事情做好准备。由于风险无处不在，加上一群不受欢迎的人，有些人可能会说他们太笨拙了，不适合参与这样的游戏。

[来自[url=https://sanguine1038.itch.io/jackleg-participants]itch.io[/url]]
